protocol.note: Offence is read only from a team's own side of team-vs-reference games and defence only from the reference's output in those games. Nothing offence/defence is ever read from a mirror — the defect that consumed V3.

compositeShareMae.measuredOn: each team's five-share distribution in its TEAM_VS_ERA_REFERENCE games, against the Tier C season-share proxy
compositeShareMae.ratioNote: Carried forward unchanged from the V4 policy. It was not weakened because V4 passed it, and it is not tightened because V4 failed elsewhere.

numericGates.unavailableMetrics: A null target (pre-1974 steals and blocks, or any unrecorded field) contributes no error, no pass credit and no failure. It is never zero-filled.

traitGates.scoredTraits: Only traits certified in historical-observability-certification-candidate1.json, on their registry surface, against the CANDIDATE 1 era-reference self-baselines.

perTrait.hardFail: direction opposite to the claim AND the 95% interval excludes zero AND |difference| > margin[metric]
perTrait.directionalSoftFail: direction opposite to the claim AND (interval includes zero OR |difference| <= margin[metric]) — reported, never verdict-driving
perTrait.dualGate: Both gates must fire. Statistical significance alone is not a failure at 4,096 games, and a large difference inside noise is not evidence.

confidenceHandling.HIGH: a hard fail on a high-confidence identity is a verdict failure on its own
confidenceHandling.MEDIUM: hard fails count toward the aggregate gates; V4's identities were all MEDIUM

aggregate.perFixtureRule: no matchup may fail a majority of its scored traits
aggregate.perEraRule: no era style may fail every scored trait of its matchup

structuralGates.candidateIdentityStated: every result must state candidateId, core hash, parameter-set hash and calibration version

data.failureSemantics: FAIL preserves every artifact, forbids tuning against V5, keeps Synthetic V2 sealed, and ends formal validation for Candidate 1. INVALID_RUN resumes under the SAME access event only.
data.immutability: After this artifact is committed no threshold, margin, trait, confidence rule, reference or target may change. Any change before V5 access requires a new policy version, a new policy hash and a new readiness package; any change after V5 access invalidates V5.
